Kimberly — thanks for the ping. I took a quick look through NovaMed_MSA_Draft_v0.9.docx and flagged the following high-level items:

1) Data retention (Sec 6): 30-day retention for logs is aggressive; our hosted runtime uses short-lived caches that are typically evicted within hours, but audit logs and billing records currently are retained longer for operational and compliance reasons.
   - Proposed compromise: 30 days for token/KV cache logs; 90 days for billing/audit logs with an option to export/delete on request.
2) PHI / Privacy carveouts (Sec 3 & Exhibit D): If they're sending PHI, we must move to Private deployment (VPC/On-prem) and sign a Data Processing Addendum.
3) Indemnity cap (Sec 11): buyer proposes uncapped liability. We should propose a reciprocal cap tied to fees (standard: 12 months of net fees) plus carveouts for gross negligence/fraud.
4) KMS/HSM (Sec 7): technically feasible — will be an add-on. I need Karthik to estimate implementation lead time and cost for HSM-backed keys.

I'll start a tracked-changes redline and attach a summary doc. If we can get Karthik's tech note today I'll incorporate that and send back to NovaMed.

Marissa Cole

Quick tech note for legal / procurement:

- Hosted (standard API): token/KV caches are ephemeral (seconds to minutes) for inference; we do not retain user prompts/responses beyond short-term caches unless customers opt-in to longer retention for analytics. Audit and billing logs are retained by default (90 days) for operational support.
- Private (VPC / Dedicated): supports per-customer isolation and can be configured for stricter retention (30 days) and KMS/HSM integration. That path requires: reserved capacity (for throughput SLA), additional infra provisioning (2–4 weeks), and a one-time provisioning fee.
- HSM/KMS: we support customer-managed KMS in Dedicated and Private; HSM integration is supported but will add ~2–4 weeks and a moderate CMA (configuration & validation) cost.
- Cost delta estimate: Dedicated + KMS provisioning + HSM on-request — ballpark $XXk setup + $Yk/month depending on node count. I'll follow up with a scoped estimate once I know expected QPS and model size.

If legal wants a short paragraph for the redline cover note I can draft one.

— Karthik
